info.description: Every client of Keystone uses this API. A call carries its session in the keystone_session cookie, and the session alone says whose data the call reaches. A route marked x-keystone-door is served before sign-in. Every answer carries an X-Request-Id header.
info.title: Keystone

The turn failed. An end event with the status failed follows.
Always the last event: the turn as it ended, with the status done, stopped or failed. The stream closes after it.
